# SCHEMA documentation

> Every document in the Pyramid Schema package, one line each — start with the root README, and see AGENTS.md for how to work here.

The specification itself is [`spec/pyramid-schema-spec-v0.1.md`](../spec/pyramid-schema-spec-v0.1.md) (one frozen file per version), the agent protocol block is [`protocol/CLAUDE.snippet.md`](../protocol/CLAUDE.snippet.md), and the fixture repo is [`example/acme-app/`](../example/acme-app/README.md). Essays and reports under `docs/` are dated `YYYY-MM-DD-slug.md`.
